title: Read a named key
summary: PowerShell: Read a named key. Read Pages instead.
introduction: A hashtable pairs keys with values. Brackets select a value by key.
learningObjectives: Read a named key with PowerShell

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
The Title key selects Moon Trip from the hashtable.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Separate hashtable entries with a semicolon or a new line.
